goal: Public VII page navigation feels immediate because safe route data is warmed early, independent homepage work runs concurrently and eligible anonymous responses are reused.

intent_model.literal_request: Make page loading as fast as realistically possible so a visitor clicks and gets an immediate result.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Remove verified latency from real navigation rather than merely decorating the wait.
likely_rejections: One route improved while others regressed.
The change was not actually published.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Begin safe destination work before the click and keep post-click work off the critical path.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Measure an exact browser click, not only a lab score.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The current public page becomes interactive.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: The visitor chooses another public destination.
cognitive_flow.next_action: The destination responds immediately with meaningful content.

actors: Returning public visitor on a constrained mobile network
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co public navigation, especially /hourly to / via the logo.

facts.claim: A warmed browser transition completed in about 205ms while an early transition took about 2772ms.
facts.evidence: Controlled in-app browser timing on production, 2026-10-15.

facts.claim: Production public HTML currently returns no-store without VII cache markers.
facts.evidence: Repeated direct response probes on /, /hourly, /search, /spas, /events and /business on 2026-10-15.

assumptions.claim: A five-minute anonymous homepage document TTL is acceptable because personalized and transactional requests remain excluded and live offer data is client-delivered.
assumptions.validation: Preserve exclusion tests and inspect the homepage data ownership before release.

in_scope: performance contracts and real navigation measurement
publication when the existing exact Site target is available
invariants: Cookie, Authorization, RSC, admin, account, favorites and booking traffic never enters the public cache.
Save-Data and 2G visitors are not force-prefetched.
Public content, routes, locale and design remain unchanged.
No live claim without exact deployment evidence.

requirements.statement: Start the likely homepage navigation warmup immediately after hydration on eligible public routes.
Remove avoidable serial homepage data work while preserving rendered output.
Reuse eligible anonymous public documents with bounded freshness while excluding private and router-state traffic.
Verify and publish the exact release, or report publication as blocked without overstating completion.

acceptance_checks.setup: A hydrated eligible non-home route on a normal connection.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect the warmup and click the logo after the effect can run.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Prefetch starts without idle/timer delay and the controlled warmed transition is below 500ms.

acceptance_checks.setup: Save-Data, 2G, private route, Cookie, Authorization or RSC state.
acceptance_checks.action: Load the route or request the document.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No forced warmup or shared public-cache response occurs.

acceptance_checks.action: Trace the independent data promises and run focused tests/build.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Rated-place detail loading overlaps other world summaries and output contracts pass.

acceptance_checks.setup: Two eligible anonymous document requests within the TTL.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The second exact production response reports a VII cache HIT with bounded expiry.

acceptance_checks.setup: A verified candidate commit and known prior production identity.
acceptance_checks.action: Publish once and repeat the route-family checks.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The exact release passes or the task remains not verified with the blocker and rollback identity recorded.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, verification and publication to the already authorized VII Site are allowed; alternate projects, DNS and private caching are not.
